sabancimerkezcamii.name: Sabancı Merkez Mosque
sabancimerkezcamii.slogan: Six slim minarets standing guard over the Seyhan.
sabancimerkezcamii.line: Opened in 1998, its six minarets rise 99 metres and the prayer hall holds about 28,500 people.

taskopru.name: Taşköprü Roman Bridge
taskopru.slogan: Two thousand years of footsteps over the Seyhan.
taskopru.line: This Roman bridge, probably from Hadrian's reign, carried cars until 2007 and is now for walkers only.

karatepe.name: Karatepe-Aslantaş
karatepe.slogan: A forest hilltop where lions guard a king's gate.
karatepe.line: Its 8th-century BC gate inscription, in Phoenician and Luwian hieroglyphs, helped scholars decipher the Anatolian hieroglyphs.

yilankale.name: Yılankale (Snake Castle)
yilankale.slogan: A Cilician crown on a rock above the Ceyhan.
yilankale.line: Armenian king Leo I built it around 1200; its Armenian name, Levonkla, means Levon's fortress.

anavarza.name: Anavarza (Anazarbus)
anavarza.slogan: A Roman victory arch below a fortress-crowned crag on the plain.
anavarza.line: Anazarbus was the home town of Dioscorides, whose De Materia Medica guided medicine for 1,500 years.
